note: All text of the elves mechanic (docs/specs/04_mechanics/elves_wall_and_dragons.md). Keys: events by id (t title, d description, o option names in order, v description variants), decisions, categories, ideas, dynamic modifiers, opinion modifiers. No line names Afrit or calls the Deliverer or the Worshipdom dark before the reveal, says where Varner is, or says the elves will march.

zin_elves_kin.d: The business of the elven houses: the moot, the Kindred, the Wall, the passes and the pilgrim roads.

zin_elves_wanderers.d: Healers, loremasters and wardens who walk among other peoples as individuals. They are no host and no league.

zin_elves_roosts.d: The Keeper's care of the dragon roosts on the mountain.

zin_elves_call_elder_moot.d: Summon the speakers of the houses to the council ring and ask what the moot should speak of first.

zin_elves_raise_the_kindred.n: Raise the Kindred of the Woods
zin_elves_raise_the_kindred.d: Bind the elven houses into a league for the defence of the woods. It takes in only elves and never marches for men.

zin_elves_mediate_rivals.n: Mediate Between Herrodon and Andos Enda
zin_elves_mediate_rivals.d: Send speakers with open hands between the two old rivals, so that the quarrel of the groves cools before it burns.

zin_elves_settle_the_feud.n: Settle the Feud of the Groves
zin_elves_settle_the_feud.d: The old quarrel has run past mediation. Claim the boundary groves and take up the cause of war against the rival house.

zin_elves_wardens_for_the_passes.d: Send wardens up to Nolorim's high passes to raise stone and watch fires against whatever comes over the snow.

zin_elves_call_wall_moot.n: Call a Wall Moot at the Gate
zin_elves_call_wall_moot.d: Ask the crown's customs men to hear the elves in open moot at the Wall gate, on the tolls and the cold roads.

zin_elves_close_the_wall_roads.d: Shut the elven gates along the Great Wall. The Accord is not broken, but no caravan will pass either way.

zin_elves_reopen_the_wall_roads.d: Unbar the elven gates and let the caravans walk the Wall road again.

zin_elves_open_wall_gates.n: Open the Wall Gates to Aenoran Companies
zin_elves_open_wall_gates.d: Give Aenor, its vassals and Kingson right of passage through the Wall gates. Men may come to stand beside the woods; this does not set the Refusal aside.

zin_elves_bar_wall_gates.d: End the right of passage given at the Wall gates. The woods settle behind their own bars.

zin_elves_pilgrim_roads_open_decision.d: Let pilgrims cross the woods freely, with hostels and fire along the way. Their gifts fill the roadside towns.

zin_elves_pilgrim_roads_toll_decision.d: Take a toll at the pilgrim gates. The treasury is fuller, and the hermitage in the hills remembers it.

zin_elves_pilgrim_roads_close_decision.d: Turn every pilgrim back at the edge of the woods. The roads stay empty and the hermitage takes it ill.

zin_elves_seek_the_wizard.d: Send quiet word through the old ways to the wizard of the Unbinding. Nobody can say who will answer, or how.

zin_elves_send_healers.d: Send healers and loremasters to sit in another realm's halls for a year. They bring no banner and take no side.

zin_elves_send_wardens.n: Send Wardens to a Friend in Need
zin_elves_send_wardens.d: Let wardens of the woods walk to a realm at war with the dark. They go as individuals, not as a host, and return when the season turns.

zin_elves_tend_the_roosts.d: Send the roost-singers to the mountain with salt, song and green boughs, so that the dragons keep their trust in the Keeper.

zin_elves_refusal_set_aside.d: The woods have set the Refusal aside for this war. They will take it up again when the war is over.

zin_elves_wanderers_lore.d: Healers and loremasters of the woods sit in our halls, mending the sick and copying old books.

zin_elves_wanderers_lore_gala.d: Healers of the Gala elves walk our towns, and the lore they bring has been kept by the water for ages.

zin_elves_wanderers_wardens.d: Grey-cloaked wardens of the woods hold our border villages. They answer to no one in our court.

zin_elves_wall_roads_shut.d: The elven gates along the Wall stand barred. Goods pile at the barriers, and the woods keep close to their own.

zin_elves_pilgrim_roads_open.d: Pilgrims cross our woods in their hundreds, and the hostels along the road have never been busier.

zin_elves_pilgrim_tolls.d: Every pilgrim pays at the gate. The coffers are heavier, and the pilgrims grumble.

zin_elves_varners_counsel.d: An unsigned letter in an old hand answered what we asked. Scholars and wardens work to its plain advice.

zin_elves_wizard_gone.d: Word has come that the wizard of the Unbinding is no more. The woods are uneasy, and their resolve is hard.

zin_elves_woods_defended.d: Every grove is a rampart and every elder a sentry. The woods fight on ground they have loved for ages.

zin_elves_gates_barred.d: The Wall gates are closed again, and the woods feel safer behind their own bars.

zin_elves.5.t: A Wall Moot at the Gate
zin_elves.5.d: Elven speakers have come down to the great gate and asked that the crown's customs men hear them in open moot. They say the tolls on the Wall road have grown heavier than the Accord of 4A 96 allows, and that the road has gone cold with it.

zin_elves.6.d: The speakers have come back from the gate with the crown's answer. The tolls stand as they were, and the road will stay cold.

v.heard: The speakers have come back from the gate with the crown's answer. The customs men heard them out, the tolls will be eased, and the elven gates will open again.

o: So it is at the Wall

zin_elves.7.d: A wild wyrm of the mountain crossed the Wall in the night and took herds on the Aenor side. The herdsmen are at the gate with what is left of the carcasses, and the king's men are watching to see what the woods will say.

zin_elves.8.d: No silver has come for the herds the dragon took. The elves say the wyrms of the mountain are no one's to keep, and the herdsmen are bitter.

v.paid: Elven factors came to the Wall villages with silver for every beast the dragon took. The herdsmen could hardly believe it, and the customs men are puzzled.

o: So it is at the Wall

zin_elves.10.d: The elven gates along the Great Wall are shut. No caravan from the Magical Lands will cross to Aenor, and none from Aenor will pass in. The elves say the Accord is unbroken; they have only stopped walking on it.

zin_elves.20.d: The old marker-trees between Herrodon and Andos Enda have been blazed afresh, and nobody will say whose axe it was. The elders of the border groves ask what Herrodon will do.
o: Leave the groves to the trees

zin_elves.21.d: At the last midsummer feast the speaker of Herrodon sat down at the high table before Andos Enda's envoy had been greeted. It was a small thing. It has been remembered for a hundred years.

zin_elves.22.d: Both Herrodon and Andos Enda claim the eastern roosts, because their grandmothers once sang there to the wyrms. The Keeper of the mountain must say whose song the dragons will hear.
o: The roost belongs to the dragons

zin_elves.23.d: Speakers of the Magical Forest have walked between Herrodon and Andos Enda with open hands. Neither house has forgotten the quarrel, but both have agreed to let the old words cool.

zin_elves.24.d: Herrodon and Andos Enda have taken up the old quarrel in earnest. Bows are strung in the boundary groves, and the kin of both houses are choosing which hand to hold.

zin_elves.25.d: A year of strife has cost both houses more trees than they cost each other. Envoys of the Magical Forest offer a peace without spoils.

zin_elves.30.d: The houses of the Magical Lands have come to the council ring beneath the silver trees. The old speakers ask what the moot should speak of first.

zin_elves.31.d: The Magical Forest has raised the Kindred of the Woods, a league of elves for the defence of elven lands. It takes in no one who is not of the woods. Every house is asked to stand with the kin.

zin_elves.32.d: The elven houses of the Magical Lands have bound themselves in the Kindred of the Woods. It is a league of defence for the woods alone, and its heralds say it will not march for men.

zin_elves.40.d: Wardens from the kin have come up to Nolorim's high passes and asked only for fire and bread. They will stay as long as the snow lets them.

zin_elves.41.d: Every high pass of Nolorim is under foreign banners. The kin in the lowlands have watched the signal fires go dark, one after another.

zin_elves.45.d: In the night a dragon rose from the mountain and flew east without a backward look. The roost-singers say something called it. They will not say what it sounded like. The roosts are restless.

v.revealed: In the night a dragon rose from the mountain and flew east without a backward look. The roost-singers found the Deliverer's priests on the mountain roads, and no one will say how long they had been there. The roosts are restless.

zin_elves.50.d: A letter lay on the table this morning, in an old hand, unsigned. Nobody saw it come in. It answers the question we asked, and a few we did not.

zin_elves.55.d: Healers and loremasters of the elven woods have come to our towns and asked leave to sit in our halls and tend our sick. They are no host and bear no banner but their own.

zin_elves.56.d: Wardens of the elven woods stand in our border villages, tall and quiet, in grey cloaks with long bows. Their king did not send them, they say. They have simply come.

zin_elves.60.d: The pilgrims' hermitage in the Zilin Hills was never what its priests said. Our wardens have seen what it is, and every road that leads there runs through our woods.

zin_elves.72.d: Aenor's envoys ask leave to send companies through the Wall gates, to stand beside the woods against the sails on the rift sea. They ask no more than a road.

zin_elves.73.d: No foreign banner now stands in the woods of the rift coast. The wardens ask whether the war should end here, or follow the sails home.
